t: A free JavaScript library for learning to code by making art.
steps: Download the library zip from the p5.js site.
Ask IT to place it on school computers or a shared drive.
Choose a text editor and a modern browser.
Make an HTML file that points to p5.min.js.
Remember that the zip has no editor.
Add p5.sound separately if you need sound. The old p5.sound file in the zip does not work with version 2.x.
Draw a circle and open the file in a browser.
